name: greerviau
description: Reusable agent skills for engineering and scientific research, one installable plugin per category.

plugins.name: greerviau-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering skills: shared standards and design vocabulary, architecture scans, planning, GitHub development workflows, design spikes, pull requests, test-driven development, technical research, dependency upgrades, debugging, flaky-test investigation, merge-conflict resolution, review, refactoring, performance optimization, doc audits, mermaid diagrams, and conversation handoffs.

plugins.name: greerviau-research
plugins.description: Scientific-research skills backed by OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, and Crossref.

plugins.name: greerviau-personal
plugins.description: Personal skills: opinion-aware decisions backed by ~/OPINIONS.md, browser-based document review with inline comments, rewriting a finished document in your own writing voice, and auditing what an agent has remembered about you.
